content: प्रेष्य {%a.%} To be ordered, sent, despatched <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-ष्यः@} .²1 A servant, menial, slave; प्रेष्यः प्रतीपोधिकृतः प्रमादी त्याज्या अमी यश्च कृतं न वेत्ति <ls>Pt. 1. 424</ls>. .²2 A messenger. .{@-ष्या@} A female servant, hand-maid. .{@-ष्यम्@} .²1 Sending on a mission. .²2 Servitude.
